title: Mountain height measured from its own base (meters)

source.name: Mauna Kea volcano profile (Hawaiian Volcano Observatory)

notes: USGS: Mauna Kea rises 4,207 m (13,803 ft) above sea level and extends about 6,000 m (19,700 ft) below it to the deep ocean floor, for a total base-to-summit height of nearly 10,211 m (33,500 ft). Guinness World Records certifies Mauna Kea as the tallest mountain measured base to tip (c. 10,205 m) against Everest's 8,849 m above sea level - the same comparison plotted here. Everest's figure is its sea-level elevation, per the 2020 joint Nepal-China survey.
